# External UI and motion resource index

This catalog indexes the resources visible in:

- Its Hover animated icons
- Great UI components
- Bencho interactive blocks
- Spell UI components
- DesignEng's free directory

The entries are intentionally attribution-aware metadata. The app does **not** copy or execute arbitrary third-party website code. Icons and blocks can be added to the Studio as editable text/resource cues, while the agent can use their source URLs and descriptions when planning a video. Remote code is never executed in the renderer.

Before vendoring any implementation or asset, verify the individual provider's license. The catalog records provider-specific licensing instead of assuming everything is open source.

Run `npm run packs:build` after updating the catalog. The result is exposed offline in the Library as `external-ui`.
